text: Thank you, that helps. Given your severe leg pain and easy bruising, have you noticed any bone tenderness or swelling when you touch your legs or hips?

text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia or Acute Myeloid Leukemia)

Based on your history of fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe leg pain waking you at night, we need to confirm this immediately. I am requesting a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential, Peripheral Blood Smear, and a Bone Marrow Biopsy. Please also request images of the leg pain area if swelling is present.
